HARBOUR LIGHTS — SEASON OUTLINE

Episode 1 — The Return
Nimal comes home from Dubai and asks what the boat would sell for. Kamala refuses to discuss it.
Sunil asks for one more year at sea.

Episode 2 — The Buyer
A hotel agent from Galle offers cash for the boat. Mrs. Perera spreads the news before lunch.
Kamala sells fish twice as early to prove the family does not need the money.

Episode 3 — Storm Season
A storm keeps the boats in harbour for a week. The debts in the auction shed ledger grow.
Sunil goes out alone against everyone's advice and does not come back by nightfall.

Episode 4 — The Search
The town searches the coast through the night. Nimal and Kamala wait together on the breakwater,
and for the first time talk about the father who drowned.
